data.memory_usage_summary: The two bootstrap-modularization memories guided verification of the deps-injection pattern (Deps interfaces on every bootstrap module), the <200-line target for start.ts, and the requirement for unit tests with fakes — all confirmed present; the global-refactor-scope memory was rejected as unrelated to this bootstrap split.
data.summary:
* Reviewed a bootstrap refactor of `workers/orchestrator/src/start.ts` (914 → 191 lines) into 8 focused modules under `bootstrap/`, with full dep-injection pattern and typed constants.
  * All 3 prior review findings (logWorkerAuthStartupStatus v8 ignore, validateWorkerApiKeys broad ignore, callOrder sequencing) were addressed in the latest commit — tests added, ignores narrowed, ordering comment fixed.
  * One remaining finding (🔴): the broad `module-init` v8 ignore on `start()` names blockers already mocked in start.test.ts, hiding testable branches for `githubPrivateKeyOverride` and `gitUserNameOverride`/`gitUserEmailOverride`; fix is 1–2 additional test cases + narrowing the ignore.
  * One minor finding (⚠️): `ts-type` v8 category misapplied to a runtime unreachable throw in `fetchWithRetry` (should be `async-timing`); advisory only.
  * All CI checks passed; overall code and test quality is high with solid dep-injection discipline throughout.
